decisions.reason: Prevent hardcoded keys in source or config files to maintain sovereign security.
decisions.decision: Execute full-fleet API key audit following Firecrawl credential synchronization.

continuation: Cline Overseer: The Firecrawl API wrappers have been fixed by synchronizing keys across .env and opencode.json. A full security audit is now required to ensure no API keys (especially the new healthy Firecrawl key) are hardcoded in source files or committed to version control. Please verify that all tools use environment variables or the secure config path.
